Definition: from G4862 and G4095; to partake a beverage in company:--drink with.
BiblicalUsage: Peter says the risen Jesus was seen not by all the people but by witnesses chosen before of God, even by the apostles, who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead. Eating and drinking with the risen Christ is the plainest proof of all: He was not a spirit but a living man with a body.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the risen Christ ate and drank with His friends, and I hold that a Saviour who shares a meal is a Saviour who truly rose.
